title: Do you have strong or weak visualization capabilities?
content: Hello again, all. Thanks for taking part in my informal little polls. This question is aimed to help me contextualize my own research operations for strategies, dispositions, and neurotypes that are not my own. If you wish to contribute relevant information along those categories, please do so. I will not attach usernames or other data to my collection of this information (i.e. it becomes anonymous as soon as I type it into my document without context).
